subject: Remove REDIS tag from REDIS_CONFIG_REWRITE_SIGNATURE. (#331)
reason: The change only renames the macro REDIS_CONFIG_REWRITE_SIGNATURE to CONFIG_REWRITE_SIGNATURE; its value, the signature string '# Generated by CONFIG REWRITE' written and recognized by CONFIG REWRITE, is byte-for-byte unchanged, and all usages are updated consistently. This is a pure identifier refactor with no behaviour change, so no test can observe a difference between the two builds.
